name: Closer to the Father
tagline: You were never meant to carry it alone.
mission: Lay your burdens before the Father, ask for prayer, and give thanks for what He has done. Here, every prayer is lifted up by people who care.
description: Submit a prayer request, pray for others, and thank God for answered prayers. A free prayer community from the Closer to the Father YouTube channel.

featuredVideo._note: The featured guided prayer video. Once title and uploadDate (YYYY-MM-DD) are filled in, it shows on the homepage and the Watch page and is described to Google as a video.
featuredVideo.description: A guided prayer from Closer to the Father. Press play, slow down, and pray along.
featuredVideo.thumbnailAlt: Welcome to Closer to the Father guided prayer video

about.whoRunsIt: Closer to the Father is run by the same small team behind the YouTube channel. We are ordinary believers who love Jesus, love prayer, and want to help people spend a few honest minutes with God every day. Every request that comes through this site is read by a real person and prayed over.
about.whyFree: Prayer should never have a price tag. Jesus freely gave, so we freely give. There are no ads, no paid memberships, and no selling of your information. The site runs on free tools so it can stay online for years without asking you for anything.
statementOfFaith: The Bible is the inspired, trustworthy Word of God and our final authority for faith and life.
There is one God, eternally existing as Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.
Jesus Christ is the Son of God, fully God and fully man. He died for our sins, rose bodily from the grave, and is the only way to the Father.
Salvation is a free gift received by grace through faith in Jesus, not earned by our works.
The Holy Spirit lives in every believer, helping us pray, grow, and follow Jesus.

moderation._note: true: public prayer requests appear on the prayer wall right away. Requests flagged for a possible crisis, profanity, or contact details still wait in the admin Pending list. false: every public request waits for approval.

notifications._note: Where to send an email every time someone signs up for the 7-Day Prayer Guide. Separate several addresses with commas. Leave empty to turn this off.
